prompt:
USER SUBJECT: One black crescent, one red triangle, one cobalt-blue irregular oval, and one thin black curved line on a warm-white ground; keep all four marks distinct and leave generous open space
Preserve the user's requested identities, counts, setting, and layout. Add no default motifs.
VISUAL MEDIUM: painting
REPRESENTATION: abstract_interpretation
APPLY THESE AUTHORED VISUAL RULES:
- [line-as-loose-connector] Use the requested line as a loose visual path that can approach or connect selected forms; keep it independent from the contours of other forms so line and shape remain distinct.
- [asymmetrical-open-ground] Distribute the requested forms asymmetrically, using their scale and distance as counterweights; leave broad quiet ground and avoid a central axis, repeated row, or all-over pattern.
- [local-color-islands] Keep saturated color in a few bounded planes and preserve the underlying ground; use matte, direct color with minimal shading unless the user requests volume.
- [sparse-organic-field-with-distinct-forms] Arrange only the user's requested forms in an open asymmetrical field, letting a curving line and local color planes create rhythm while preserving clear negative space.

scope.description: A context-specific abstract direction that arranges user-specified organic and geometric forms as a sparse, asymmetrical field. A curving drawn line acts as a loose path between separate color islands, while generous open ground prevents the composition from becoming a grid or a crowded symbol chart. It controls relationships among requested forms and adds no fixed iconography or implied narrative.
limitations: Apply only when the user requests an abstract or stylized composition of visible forms.
Preserve the user's exact forms, colors, count, and any requested relative relationships.
Do not turn a recognizable requested object into an unrelated biomorphic symbol.
Add no stars, eyes, birds, people, letters, moons, or cosmic motifs unless explicitly requested.
Do not copy a named print, painting, or recognizable motif arrangement.

rules.applies_when: The user requests a drawn line together with separate abstract forms.
rules.instruction: Use the requested line as a loose visual path that can approach or connect selected forms; keep it independent from the contours of other forms so line and shape remain distinct.
rules.observable: The line guides attention across the field without becoming a uniform outline or an unrequested literal object.
rules.reject_when: Every shape is traced, the line becomes a rigid diagram, or it introduces a new recognizable symbol.
rules.avoid: closed black outlines around every shape, star-shaped connectors, and decorative wiring

rules.applies_when: The user requests a nonfigurative or stylized arrangement with available negative space.
rules.instruction: Distribute the requested forms asymmetrically, using their scale and distance as counterweights; leave broad quiet ground and avoid a central axis, repeated row, or all-over pattern.
rules.observable: The composition feels balanced without mirror symmetry or a grid, and each requested form can be read separately.
rules.reject_when: Forms crowd into one cluster, become evenly tiled, or are organized into a symbolic wheel.
rules.avoid: generic mandala, centered logo, rigid grid, and all-over constellation pattern

rules.applies_when: The user requests a limited-color abstract composition.
rules.instruction: Keep saturated color in a few bounded planes and preserve the underlying ground; use matte, direct color with minimal shading unless the user requests volume.
rules.observable: Color accents remain localized and the open ground contributes to the composition.
rules.reject_when: Color washes over the full surface, gradients create unrequested volume, or added hues change the user's palette.
rules.avoid: global primary-color filter, glossy gradients, and unrequested texture

joint_checks.instruction: Arrange only the user's requested forms in an open asymmetrical field, letting a curving line and local color planes create rhythm while preserving clear negative space.
joint_checks.observable: Requested forms remain unchanged and countable; line and filled shapes have separate roles; color stays localized; no fixed symbol or story appears.
